page.overview:
Who is Geba?

Geba possesses a brownish-black hide with orange stripes from his neck to the tip of his tail. Half of his face is orange and the other half and his mouth is blackish-brown. He has a couple of orange patches on his legs.

Geba, a loving and devoted dinosaur, shares a strong bond with Zayna, his caretaker, forged through time and care. He exhibits playful tendencies, often sneaking up and following her, revealing a lighthearted and affectionate nature.

Geba displays a fascination with water, exemplified by his eager attempt to drink from a bucket held over Zayna's head. He curiously mouthing to access to the water, before turning to his own water container. Additionally, Geba shows interest in small buckets containing food, prompting Zayna to carefully ensure he doesn't knock them over.

Geba’s curiosity extends to new individuals, as evidenced by his enthusiastic participation in a impromptu race with Yasmina Fadoula, where he eagerly runs alongside this new person, showcasing his friendly and adventurous nature.
